The Router correctly identified the internal composition checkpoint as untestable. All other checkpoints were correctly assessed as present.

alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class label 'baseball' with high confidence (Logit 7.64), significantly higher than the next candidate. The visual features (red stitching, white leather, figure-8 pattern) align perfectly with the taxonomy. The only deduction is for the 'uniform texture' checkpoint which failed due to realistic wear/tear interpretation vs strict taxonomy, and minor geometric warping at intersections.
